products: Linear is the product development system for teams and agents: issues, projects, initiatives and roadmaps, docs and PRDs, customer requests, Linear Asks (Slack, email, and web intake into Triage), Insights and Pulse dashboards, Cycles, Git automations, a public GraphQL API and SDK, and native Diffs for PR review. Linear Agent plus coding sessions (launched June 2026; environments and browser testing August 20, 2026) let teams delegate an issue to a cloud sandbox that writes code with Claude Code or Codex, opens a pull request, and can set up, run, and test the change. Loops are scheduled or trigger-based automations for Linear Agent, with optional MCP connectors. Homepage claims more than 40,000 product teams (OpenAI, Coinbase, Ramp); CEO seven-year post cited 20k+ paid business customers — treat “teams” vs paid companies as different counts. Positioned as a faster, opinionated alternative to Atlassian/Jira, now expanding from issue tracking into agent-era execution.
fiscal_outlook: June 10, 2025 Series C of eighty-two million dollars at a one-point-two-five billion dollar valuation (Accel-led; Sequoia and 01A continued; Seven Seven Six, Designer Fund, Indie.vc and others joined; mix of primary and secondary). Crunchbase/TechCrunch: about one hundred thirty-four million dollars raised total. Company says it operates profitably and remotely; Sequoia notes profitability by July 2021. TechCrunch at Series C: ~eighty people, 15k+ customers, profits up two hundred eighty percent the prior year; CEO Karri Saarinen told Reuters the raise funds product expansion and larger enterprise clients. Around the seven-year mark, Saarinen posted a team of one hundred eighteen, 20k+ paid customers, ARR from accounts spending one hundred thousand dollars or more up 6.3x, net operating income up ~3.5x, still profitable with negative lifetime burn, and ~180%+ net revenue retention; Coinbase, Oscar Health, and Automattic named as switchers. Total ARR is not disclosed in those posts (third-party one-hundred-million-dollar ARR figures are unverified here). Founders: Karri Saarinen (CEO), Tuomas Artman (CTO), Jori Lallo. No layoff signals found.
hiring_trends: Live linear.app/careers (August 2026) still lists Senior/Staff Fullstack (North America and Europe), Senior/Staff Product Engineer (North America and Europe), and Senior/Staff Product Engineer AI (North America only), plus a mid Product Engineer (North America, two to five years — below typical staff target). Board has broadened beyond generalist eng: Technical Recruiter focused on North America engineering across product, infrastructure, AI, and mobile; Analytics Engineer; Developer Relations; Solutions Engineer (Growth and Europe/London); Product Manager; design (including Mobile and Principal); and GTM (account executives, customer success, implementation). Recruiter JD is a signal they are adding more specialized eng tracks, not only product/fullstack generalists. Remote-first with optional San Francisco, New York, and London coworking; team distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia. Culture still “keep the team small, do more with less.”
similar_role_hires: Re-verified live Senior/Staff Fullstack, Senior/Staff Product Engineer, and Senior/Staff Product Engineer AI — still the closest staff IC matches for US remote TypeScript/React/Node/Postgres work. Shared bar: five-plus years shipping customer-facing product, strong React and TypeScript plus Node, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL, end-to-end ownership, product sensibility, comfort without heavy PM, remote async. Stack from JDs: Temporal for agentic workloads at production scale, proprietary websocket sync for speed and offline, React/MobX/styled-components (StyleX on the mid Product Engineer JD), GraphQL API and SDK, Node/Postgres/Redis, Google Cloud with Kubernetes, GitHub/Slack/Notion. Fullstack work includes sync-engine serialization, collaborative editor, virtualized lists, and observability. AI role is North America only and asks for shipped applied AI, prompt/eval, and an agent platform so third-party agents can act as teammates. Product Engineer (two to five years) is the same stack but below seniority. No named Levels or LinkedIn staff hires confirmed this pass.
hiring_profile: High craft, slow and selective; Linear says it is small and profitable and intends to keep it that way. Official process (April 28, 2026): application or sourced, recruiter or hiring-manager screen with compensation on the first call, three to four team interviews, then a paid two-to-five-day work trial with internal tools; most processes four to six weeks; independent feedback, blind vote, hiring manager final call, prefer unanimous. They value slope over credentials; no OKRs or A/B tests; screens for craft, judgment, ownership, and fit with low-process remote work. Remote-first (North America and Europe for senior roles; AI role North America only). Evergreen senior/staff listings plus a Technical Recruiter for North America eng — real hiring, but the bar is high and listings can look always-open. Official careers page is the source of truth; hiring mail is @linear.app. Expect product taste and end-to-end ownership more than pure systems depth.
